body:
Independently re-confirmed on a live multi-node ObjectOS EE deployment (framework `502ff8b5`, Postgres 16) during a full platform-checklist run. Two agents reproduced it from their own fixtures: a guarded `PATCH /api/v1/data/<obj>/<id>` with `If-Match` set to the read-served `updated_at` (ISO `2026-08-30T09:49:05.698Z`) returns `409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE` on an uncontested version, and the only accepted token is the 409 body's `currentVersion` in `Date.toString()` form (`Sun Aug 30 2026 09:49:05 GMT+0000 (Coordinated Universal Time)`); an unguarded PATCH falls through to last-write-wins. Source confirmed at `normaliseVersionToken` (`protocol.ts:9744`, `String()` with no Date→ISO canonicalization) — memory-driver pins keep ISO strings so they stay green, which is why it only surfaces against a real Postgres deployment. Not re-filing; recording the live corroboration here.

QA-source: #13404 · records-forms.concurrent-edit-conflict · clause 0

## 分诊定级 · 首次定级 · `bug` · **p1** · `domain:engine` · `pm:queue`

⚠️ 本卡自 07:30 起**零标签**,静置约 17 小时。本轮全量对账扫出。

### p1:**postgres 上每一次保存都 409**,而 sqlite 无感

Console 记录编辑弹窗**恒 409 `CONCURRENT_UPDATE`**,即便该记录从未被人碰过。⇒ 在生产默认驱动上,**乐观锁把正常写入全部拒掉**。这不是边缘形状,是主路径。

⭐ 卡自己给出了最有说服力的一行证据:报错里的 `current` 与 `expected` 是**同一瞬间**(`18:19:25+08:00` == `10:19:25Z`)—— 一个冲突检测器把**同一个时刻**判成了冲突。

而 **sqlite 开发环境完全无感**,所以它活了下来。⚠️ 这条本身值得记:**一个只在生产驱动上出现的缺陷,开发环境的绿色是它的保护色。**

### 域锚定(本轮实测,⛔ 不按卡面包名猜)

卡写 `@objectstack/rest` / `@objectstack/driver-sql`。实测:

```
packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:1378  function normaliseVersionToken(v: unknown): string | null
packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:9979  const expected = normaliseVersionToken(expectedVersion)
packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:9982  const currentVersion = normaliseVersionToken((current as any).updated_at)
```

⇒ 落点是 **`packages/metadata-protocol`**,按车道表归 **`domain:engine`**(与 #13216 上 engine 席位给出的落点表同锚)。⛔ 不是 `packages/rest`。

### ⛔ 范围与必答

- **修法必须是「比较前归一到同一表示」**,⛔ 不是「把 `String()` 换成 `toISOString()`」就收工 —— 必答项:`normaliseVersionToken` 的**输入域**有哪几种(pg 回 `Date`、sqlite 回字符串、驱动可能回 number),用**枚举**回答,并对每一种给出归一后的表示;
- **必做的非空控制**:在 **postgres** 上跑;⛔ sqlite 绿不构成证据 —— 那正是这个缺陷藏了这么久的原因;
- ⚠️ 时区注记:报错串里的 `GMT+0800` 说明某处走了本地时区格式化。归一必须落在**绝对时刻**上,⛔ 不得依赖 `TZ`。

That is the known payload-channel hazard (#13385 · #13373 · #13387). ⛔ Do not treat the truncated text as the whole card. Open the issue page and read the full reproduction before you plan anything.

⚠️ **The two comments disagree on where the function is** — the live-corroboration comment says `protocol.ts:9744`, triage says the definition is at `:1378` with call sites at `:9979` / `:9982`. ## Dispatch order — three zones

**Zone 1 is not re-adjudicable. Zone 2 is a PM assumption you are asked to try to FALSIFY. Zone 3 is discardable.**

### Zone 1 — RULINGS (the first four are triage's, carried verbatim)

> - **修法必须是「比较前归一到同一表示」**,⛔ 不是「把 `String()` 换成 `toISOString()`」就收工 —— 必答项:`normaliseVersionToken` 的**输入域**有哪几种(pg 回 `Date`、sqlite 回字符串、驱动可能回 number),用**枚举**回答,并对每一种给出归一后的表示;
> - **必做的非空控制**:在 **postgres** 上跑;⛔ sqlite 绿不构成证据 —— 那正是这个缺陷藏了这么久的原因;
> - ⚠️ 时区注记:报错串里的 `GMT+0800` 说明某处走了本地时区格式化。归一必须落在**绝对时刻**上,⛔ 不得依赖 `TZ`。

**R4. Answer the input-domain question by ENUMERATION, not by listing the cases you happen to think of.** Derive the set from what the drivers actually return, and give the normalised representation for each. A fix that handles `Date` and string but is silent on the third case is not finished.

**R5. ⛔ A green sqlite run is not evidence here — it is the camouflage.** If this container cannot run a real Postgres, say so plainly and describe what you could and could not measure. ⛔ Do NOT substitute a sqlite pass and call the card verified; an honest "not measured on the driver that matters" is worth more than a false green. (CI runs `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, so a real Postgres exists in CI even if not locally.)

**R6.** No test may be skipped, disabled, quarantined, allow-listed, deleted or re-baselined. In particular ⛔ do not relax an existing OCC pin to accommodate the new normalisation — if a pin genuinely encodes the old broken comparison, that is a finding to report, not a line to edit.

**R7.** Worktree-first. ⛔ **Never `git stash`** — `refs/stash` lives in the common `.git`, shared across every worktree.

### Zone 2 — PM MECHANISM ASSUMPTION (measure it; falsification is a good outcome)

The PM's reading is that this is **one defect with one root** — a comparison between two representations of the same instant — and therefore that normalising both sides at the single `normaliseVersionToken` seam fixes every caller at once.

**Try to falsify it.** Specifically: is `normaliseVersionToken` the *only* place a version token is compared or emitted? The corroboration comment reports that the 409 body's `currentVersion` is served in `Date.toString()` form and that **that string is the only token the server will accept** — which means the broken representation is not merely compared internally, it is **published to clients**. If some client or test has already adapted to the broken form, a normalisation fix changes what the wire accepts, and that is a wider blast radius than a one-seam repair. Measure it and report.

### Zone 3 — SUGGESTED ROUTE (discard freely)

- ⭐ The card's sharpest evidence is that `current` and `expected` in the error are the **same instant** (`18:19:25+08:00` == `10:19:25Z`). A regression test that asserts *"two spellings of one instant do not conflict"* pins the property rather than the spelling, and would survive a future representation change.
- The `GMT+0800` in the error suggests a local-time formatter somewhere. Worth checking whether the same formatter feeds anything else user-visible.

### STOP conditions

- The blast radius turns out to be wire-visible (clients depending on the `Date.toString()` token) ⇒ report before changing what the endpoint accepts; that is a compatibility decision, not a bug fix.
- You cannot run Postgres ⇒ report that plainly; ⛔ do not proceed to a sqlite-only verification and present it as done.
